book.name: Luka
book.title: LUKA Pâri ara ŋana Yesu Kirisi kâ Luka iŋgere

content: Sugorai taine toŋge io ne patarawâŋa ilâ pa Maro Kindeni
Ŋineŋga Yesu mata kâki imoranzi mbaliŋa warakanzi pinde sikai mbumbu simâ, aku sio lâ pinze ŋinde ikeno Maro Kindeni ne luma sapâŋa ilo, ŋana siveta nenzi patarawâŋa kâ.
Aku Yesu imora sugorai taine mwala toŋge kala io mbumbu kiri-kiri rua indue pinze ilo.
Ŋineŋga Yesu iporo tu, “Naŋa aporo mao nâ pami; sugorai taine mwala ŋine nde io mbumbu ŋalae tina, ipole mbumbu ŋinde kinzi mbaliŋa warakanzi rârâni muŋga sio lâ pinze ilo.

Ŋana tu kinzi rârâni nenzi mbumbu rârâ keno panzi, aku sio pinde nâ ilâ pinze ilo. Aŋga taine ŋine nde imo sugorai ndo, andeta io ne mbumbu ndoni, kala i ne mbumbu toŋge ikeno papa ŋana iko kapwa kâ, ande tia.”
Yesu iporo ŋgua ŋana Maro Kindeni ne luma sapâŋa ma zavaruŋa pwapwataki

Kinzi pâri-tamâta matanzi ilâ silea pa Maro Kindeni ne luma sapâŋa, aku siporo mine tu, “Kinzi tamâta muŋga sikai mira arara ku sisaŋgara lâ luma tini itogo siŋgâra mine. Aku sikai nenzi kelekele arara tona silua Maro Kindeni lâ, ŋineŋga sisaŋgarana ŋinde itogo luma ne siŋgâra mine.” Andeta Yesu itu lâ kawanzi tu,

“Naŋa atu aporo ŋgua pami ŋana kelekele kala miki kamora ŋine. Zo toŋge ma muli ipâŋga, aku lâ zo ŋinde, kinzi ma sipile luma ŋine ne mira toŋge ikeno mira toŋge kulu, ande ma tia. Kinzi ma sitambiranzi mira rârâni ŋine ndue keno.”
Yesu itula ŋgua ŋana malia rârâ ma muli ipâŋga
Ŋineŋga kinzi pâri-tamâta sikasoŋa Yesu tu, “Pananâŋa, mâsi kanaŋo ŋine ma ipâŋga lâ zo ndia. Aku mâsi ndia ma ipâŋga muŋga ŋana itula pwataki tu zo ŋinde laiti ŋana ipâŋga kâ.”

Ŋineŋga Yesu ipainzi tu, “Miki kapakatona sondo ŋga. Tia ma kinzi sikai laŋeŋa pami. Ŋana tu tamâta rârâ ma simâ ku sipatu naŋa ŋâŋgu, aku ma siporo tu, ‘Naŋa warakâŋgu kala Kirisi’. Aku ma sipaimi tu, ‘Ayo, zo ŋga imâ ipâŋga laiti lâ’. Andeta miki ma kalâ kapono muli panzi ndimo.

Ambo tu miki ma kaloŋo ŋgua ŋananzi lawea pinde siveta paraŋa ŋalae, ande miki ma karuru ndimo. Ŋana tu vetâŋa ŋinde ma ipâŋga muŋga lâ ŋga, andeta zo ŋana tâno ŋine ne zo marumbu kâ ma ipâŋga walele tia.”
Yesu iporo ŋgua ŋine lâ, ŋineŋga ipainzi tu, “Kinzi tamâta lâ lawea pinde ma simandi sikai kazâŋa panzi tamâta lâ lawea pinde. Aŋga kinzi ŋgu pinde ma simandi sikai kazâŋa panzi ŋgu pinde.

Ogigi ŋalaŋala ma siveta tâno ririŋo, aku putole ŋalae tava pukoŋa sakamao ŋalaŋala ma sipâŋga lâ lawea rârâ. Kinzi tamâta ma simora mâsi ŋalaŋala kie-kie ipâŋga lâ samba tini, aku ŋinde ma ivetanzi siruru ŋalae tina.

Andeta vetâŋa rârâni ŋinde ma ipâŋga tia yo, ande kinzi ma sikai miki kaika, ku ma siveta malia pami. Miki uru kalomi tawana naŋa, aku ŋana duvi ŋine kâ kinzi ma siomi lâ ŋgua nia lâ luma ŋana pasauŋa kâ ilo. Ŋineŋga ma siomi kalâ luma sakamao ilo, ku ma sikaimi siŋgunumi kamandi lâ kinzi koipu ŋalaŋala wa tamâta mbâna-mbâna naonzi.
Andeta vetâŋa ŋinde nde itogo miki nemi nzâla ŋana kaporo katula pâri ara panzi tamâta ŋalaŋala ŋinde kâ.
Andeta miki ma kalomi loko muŋga ŋana ŋgua ndia miki ma kaporo taulo panzi, mine ndimo.

Ŋana tu naŋa warakâŋgu ma ao ŋgua lâ miki kawami ŋana kaporo katula panzi, aku naŋa ma ilo-kalo ara alami. Mine kala nemi kazâŋa tamâta ŋinde ma sikura tu sileleami ku sitawa nemi ŋgua ŋinde ndue, ande tia ndo.

Andeta ŋandai kinzi tamâta ŋinde simbonzi nâ ma sio miki kalâ kazâŋa tamâta mbaunzi ilo ŋga. Miki tinami-tamami wa taimi-tuami wa seemi taitu wa nimi-nambwe wa, kinzi ŋinde kala ma siomi lâ kazâŋa tamâta mbaunzi ilo. Ŋineŋga kinzi kazâŋa tamâta ma sipu miki pinde pâta kamâte.
Mao nâ, kinzi tamâta rârâni ma wisinzi nâna ŋalae tina ŋanami, ŋana tu nemi kalo-tawana ikeno pa naŋa.
Andeta kinzi ma sikura tu sitapa miki piti lâ Maro Kindeni mbau ilo, ande tia ndo.
Ambo miki nemi kalo-tawana ma ikeno kaika, ande Maro Kindeni ma via mao ilami, ma kamo viami mine ku kamo nâ.”
Yesu itula ŋgua tu muli kinzi ma sizavaru Jerusalem lawea
Yesu iporo kilo mine tu, “Lâ zo ŋana miki kamoranzi kazâŋa tamâta simâ simandi siŋge Jerusalem lawea, ŋineŋga ma kasama tu zo laiti ŋana sizavaru lawea ŋinde kâ.

Lâ zo ŋinde, ande ara ŋana kinzi tamâta simo lâ Judia tâno ma sikâwa silâ pa nia tuu. Aku ara ŋana kinzi tamâta simo Jerusalem lawea ilo ŋinde ma sipile lawea ku siyâti silâ pa nia pinde. Aŋga tamâta ea simo tâno ilo, ande kinzi ŋinde ma sitaulo silâ lawea ilo ndimo.
Ŋana tu zo ŋinde nde zo ŋana Maro Kindeni ma ipare nia panzi tamâta kâ. Mine kala i kawa ŋgua rârâni ŋinde muŋga siŋgere lâ pepa tini, ande ma ipâŋga kanaŋo.

Aku lâ zo ŋinde, kalo-sukâŋa ŋalae ma ilâ panzi taine kâpwa-kâpwa wa kinzi taine ŋinde natunzi simo suu tini yo, ŋana tu malia ŋalae ndo ma ipâŋga lâ tâno ŋine, aku Maro Kindeni ne wisi-nâna ŋalae ma ipâŋga panzi tamâta ŋgu ŋine.

Kinzi kazâŋa tamâta ma sipunzi tamâta pinde pâta simâte. Aŋga pinde nde ma sikainzi silâ simo sugorai tamâta panzi tinikoa ŋgu lâ tâno ndoni. Aku kinzi tinikoa ŋgu ma siveta kenzi sakamao panzi tamâta simo Jerusalem lawea lee, ikura lâ zo ndia Maro Kindeni ma itoto nenzi zo ŋana siveta mine kâ.”
Mâsi pinde ma imâ ipâŋga, ŋineŋga Tamâta Natu ma itaulo imâ kilo

Yesu iporo ŋgua kilo tu, “Lâ zo muli, ande mâsi kilala kie-kie ma ipâŋga lâ kari wa nzimona wa pitu wa tininzi. Kinzi tâno tamâta ma simora tâi ilâ wa imâ wa, ne nduŋeŋani ŋalae tina, aku ma siruru pâta ku ma ilonzi rârâ tona.
Kinzi tamâta ma ilonzi putuka ŋalae tina tu, ‘Kala ŋine mâsi ndia ma ipâŋga lâ tâno kulu!’ Kinzi ma ilonzi ruruŋa kala ma naonzi lâma, ŋana tu samba tini ne siŋgâra ma iyoka marumbuni.
Ŋineŋga kinzi tamâta ma simora naŋa Tamâta Natu amo take-take toŋge ŋgini amâ tava walo ŋalae, aku ma simora kilalâŋgu pwataki tu naŋa nde Maro Ŋalae.
Mine nde lâ zo ŋana vetâŋa ŋinde ma imâ ipâŋga kâ, ande miki ma kamandi kaika, ŋana tu Maro Kindeni ne zo ŋana iyautemi piti lâ kazâŋa ŋinde ilo, ande imâ laiti lâ.”
Ŋgua tambirâŋa ŋana kâi pâla-pâla itula zo
Ŋineŋga Yesu iporo ŋgua tambirâŋa panzi tu, “Miki kalomi ŋgere ŋana kâi pâla-pâla wa kâi rârâni wa.
Lâ zo ŋana kâi rârâni sirumba ku lau wasaseki ipâŋga, ande miki warakami kakura tu kamora wa kasama tu kari ne zo ŋga imâ ipâŋga laiti lâ.
Aku mine nâ, ambo miki ma kamora vetâŋa rârâni ŋinde imâ ipâŋga lâ, ŋineŋga miki ma kasama tu Maro Kindeni ne zo ŋana ikai maro panzi tamâta kâ nde imâ ipâŋga laiti lâ.
Naŋa aporo mao nâ pami; kinzi tamâta lâ zo ŋine ma simâte tia yo, ŋineŋga mâsi rârâni ŋinde ma imâ ipâŋga.
Mao nâ, samba wa tâno wa ma muli marumbu lâ, aŋga naŋa kawâŋgu ŋgua nde ma marumbu tia ndo, ma ikeno mine ku imo nâ.”
Ŋgua ŋana tapakatona sondo kâ

Yesu iporo kilo mine tu, “Miki kapakatona sondo ŋga; tia ma miki kanu lââ kaika potomule ku kadauda, aku ma kalomi loko ŋana karaemi ne kelekele kâ. Ambo miki ma kaveta mine, ande naneŋgu zo ŋana ataulo amâ kilo kâ ma ipâŋga walele pami, itogo nimbu uru ikainzi simbi walele mine.
Ŋana tu naneŋgu zo ŋinde ma ipâŋga panzi tamâta rârâni simo nia ndoni lâ tâno kulu.

Mine kala kapakatona sondo ikura zo zo. Aku ara ŋana miki ma kakai noŋa pa Maro Kindeni tu ma ipu tini kaika pa nemi kalo-tawana, ŋana vetâŋa rârâni ŋinde ma muli ipâŋga pami. Ambo miki ma kamandi kaika nâ, ande muli miki ma kakura tu kamandi lâ naŋa Tamâta Natu naoŋgu.”
Ikura kari kari, Yesu uru ipanananzi tamâta lâ Maro Kindeni ne luma sapâŋa. Aŋga mbo mbo, ande i uru iyâti ilâ ikeno lâ tuu toŋge kulu, i ŋa tu Oliv Tuu.
Aku ikura zo rârâni, lâ mbwale pwataki, kinzi tamâta rârâni uru simandi ku silâ pa Maro Kindeni ne luma sapâŋa ŋana siloŋo i ne ŋgua kâ.
